objective: Use the Thunderhorn Cleansing Totem at the Thunderhorn Water Well, then return to Mull.

description: The totem is ready, <name>.  And again, it is your task to perform the ritual of cleansing.
Go to the Thunderhorn Water Well, north of the village, and use the Thunderhorn Cleansing Totem in your ritual.  After you do this, return to me.
progress: The Thunderhorn Water Well is still tainted, <name>.  Please, you must perform the ritual!
completion: Ancestors of the Thunderhorn clan spoke to me in a dream, praising you for your actions near their well.
For their gratitude, they wish to give you this...
